entities.name: Hilmi Ziya Ülken
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hilmi Ziya Ülken (1901–1974) was a Turkish scholar and writer who had an influential role in the development of sociological and philosophical views in Turkey. In addition to his scientific work, he produced literary work, including poems.
